workload: Two authorized existing generated movies with different wrappers but identical coded H264 packets. Same independent FFprobe indexes supplied to both strategies; actual source reads and packet creation included. Baseline retains private immutable packet bytes per owner; candidate retains one verified byte/config-keyed payload with separate per-file ordered references.
sampling: Nine alternating pairs, fresh Python object graph and collected heap each. Live and peak tracemalloc bytes include packet lists, content index, hashes and object overhead; exclude common FFprobe indexes and interpreter/OS native allocations.
threshold: Every reconstructed packet list must exactly match each file independently, poisoned claims rejected, references released. Candidate median live traced allocations must be at least10% lower to support memory pursuit in this small exact sharing workload. Runtime CPU time and peak allocations reported without claiming CPU or whole-process RSS savings.
